blocks.text: Aldergrove Houses for Sale and Other Homes

parts.t: Most homes for sale in Aldergrove are detached houses, many on town lots near the core at Fraser Highway and 272 Street, with rural acreages around the edge of town. Townhomes, condos and manufactured homes also come up for sale. Aldergrove is on the eastern border of the Township of Langley, and the Township describes it as a small urban-rural community.

For detached homes, the Aldergrove sales table above shows what sold in the MLS® sub-area over the last 12 months, including the median year built and lot size. Use it with the live listings to judge price, then ask me for the sales on the exact street.

The Aldergrove Core Area Plan covers about 80 acres centred on Fraser Highway and 272 Street. The plan expects about 6,650 people in the core by 2041, so ask what is planned around any home near the centre.
Detached houses on town lots, close to the Aldergrove Community Centre at 27032 Fraser Highway, with its arena, fitness centre and pools.
Land outside the urban area falls under the Township's Rural Plan, and most of it is in the Agricultural Land Reserve. These are the acreage and hobby-farm listings.
Aldergrove Regional Park covers 280 hectares across Langley and Abbotsford, with walking and riding trails and an off-leash dog area off Lefeuvre Road.
The Aldergrove port of entry on Highway 13 is open daily from 8am to midnight.

What kinds of homes are for sale in Aldergrove?
Mostly detached houses on town lots, plus acreages on rural land around the town, and some townhomes, condos and manufactured homes. The live listings above update daily.
Is there a plan for the Aldergrove town centre?

Yes. The Aldergrove Core Area Plan covers about 80 acres centred on Fraser Highway and 272 Street and expects about 6,650 people by 2041. Ask the Township of Langley what applies to a lot before you buy.
What should I check on an Aldergrove acreage?
ALR status on the Agricultural Land Commission map, zoning with the Township, well flow and water quality, septic age, and whether barns and outbuildings had permits.
Aldergrove Community Secondary, grades 9 to 12. Catchments are set by address, so check the SD35 School Locator for the exact home.

Aldergrove offers authentic country-town character with larger lots, rural atmosphere, and the relaxed lifestyle that attracts buyers seeking alternatives to suburban density. This established Langley community features tree-lined streets with well-maintained homes, many on spacious properties offering gardens, workshops, or room for hobbies and outdoor storage. Residents appreciate the genuine small-town feel where people know their neighbours, support local businesses along Fraser Highway, and participate in community events bringing everyone together.

The area provides excellent value with diverse housing from character homes to renovated properties and newer builds, all priced reasonably compared to more urban Langley neighbourhoods. Despite the country atmosphere, shopping and services meet daily needs locally, and Highway 1 access makes regional commuting practical. Schools serve the community well, and abundant parks plus proximity to Campbell Valley Regional Park provide recreation opportunities.
